name: coactl
description: Local web app to manage native AI coding skills across tools, with a clear Global vs Project split.

scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @coactl/domain && npm run dev -w @coactl/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @coactl/domain && npm run build -w @coactl/server && npm run build -w @coactl/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @coactl/domain && npm run build -w @coactl/domain && npm run test -w @coactl/server
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @coactl/domain && npm run lint -w @coactl/server && npm run lint -w @coactl/web
